_what: Everything a member swaps to rebuild this look on their own take. transcribe.py, cut.py and build.py all read it. Every value below is an EXAMPLE showing the shape: Claude fills it from the member's own take before each build.
_keep_note: Source-second ranges to keep, in order (example values). Cut points go in measured pauses; don't trim gaps under 0.15 s (micro-trims read as stutters).
_fixes_note: fixes: wrong word -> right word (as whisper wrote it). time_fixes: "text@whisper_start" -> the real onset in source seconds. Both start empty.
_hook_note: hook_tag = a 3-4 word LABEL in the member's own words, not a sentence. It shows from frame 0 to hook_seconds.
_keep_case_note: Words that keep their capitals in the sentence-case captions (acronyms, names).
_caption_groups_note: [first word index, last word index, optional emphasis word index] from the word list cut.py prints. 2-3 words, one line, ONE bold word in about half the captions. Example values.
_card_note: The prop: a 'redacted' list card in the member's own words. reveal_word = the word index that clears a row's black bar; hidden: true = a point said after the clip (stays redacted). Only use the card on a take that IS a list; otherwise empty rows and drop the meter. Example text.
_meter_note: Fill steps from 'from' to 'to' on step_word (a word index); labels are list fractions, not %.
_punch_note: punch_word = the word index where the prop leaves and the ONE hard punch-in lands. zoom_origin_y = the member's chin (y px).
_cta_note: null = no CTA (the default: never invent a keyword). Only if the member has a REAL comment-keyword funnel and says it in the take: {"line1": "COMMENT \"YOURWORD\"", "line2": "what they get"}.
